bio: Hilton Liverpool City Centre is a landmark property situated in the heart of the remodelled city centre. Close to the Liver Buildings, Albert Dock and River Mersey, the hotel is set beside the array of shops in and around Liverpool One and less than a 5 minutes walk away from the Arena Convention Centre Liverpool and Echo Arena.  Afternoon Tea is served in the contemporary Pima Lounge, located on the ground floor, which also features a spacious sun terrace - the ideal place to unwind with Afternoon Tea while enjoying the stunning architecture and landscaping of Chavasse Park. Groups of 10 or more will be seated in the Exchange Restaurant, which also overlooks Chavasse Park.  Enjoy the sounds of an acoustic singer every Sunday afternoon.
